The '''InterStellar Regulators''' were a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]], second only to prominent [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans as one of the most successful and well-equipped mercenary outfits of its era, with a string of successful military campaigns on countless neutral worlds. The Regulators accepted an exclusive contract to serve as the military and police force of [[Makeb]], located on the edge of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], in [[3648 BBY]].<ref name="Codex" />

[[3638 BBY|Ten years later]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] prepared for its [[Conquest of Makeb|takeover]] of Makeb, and bribed several high-ranking officers of the Regulators to aid them in staging a coup. Many rank-and-file members refused to betray the people they had been hired to protect, but ended up being executed by their former comrades or fleeing the planet.<ref name="Codex" />

{{GameDS}}
The vast majority of them were wiped out by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to prevent the Regulators leaking information about the Empire's involvement on Makeb. They used their laser drills to destabilize locations where the mercenaries were stationed, burying them in magma and rubble.<ref name="Revenge of the Archon" />
{{Endgame}}
